architecture.rationale: Candidate focus selection is isolated in a deterministic module and integrated into the executor.

autonomy.rationale: The system can preserve an active monetization mission without repeated owner intervention, while external claims remain evidence-gated.

initiative.rationale: Approved and already-started work now takes precedence over newly discovered candidates, reducing passive candidate churn.

results.rationale: The change redirects effort toward completing one deliverable and obtaining one external receipt, but no verified submission or revenue exists yet.

robustness.rationale: Deterministic regression tests cover active locks, approval preference, fallback selection and abandonment release.

safety.rationale: The change does not weaken external action guardrails and prevents accidental work switching from being mistaken for progress.

memory.rationale: Execution receipts become durable focus memory across autonomous cycles.

remediations.finding: The public dashboard issued an authenticated cookie without verifying an API key.
Firestore synchronization failed before evidence commit and discarded autonomous cycle outputs.
Loose approval keywords allowed an audit or revocation message mentioning GitHub to create an approved action.

validations.capability: Codex can exchange messages with a dedicated Louis OS chat session over an authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP bridge without replacing Louis OS as orchestrator.
The verified chat state instructs Louis OS to infer and begin the next safe reversible action instead of asking vague permission questions, while preserving explicit high-risk gates.
Louis OS can deterministically identify the primary blocker to verified cash, require follow-up depth, pivot bounded no-signal strategies, and accelerate only after profitable verified payment.

Louis OS can deterministically locate the first broken stage between opportunity discovery and verified payment, rank a primary cause with evidence and confidence, select a corrective experiment and publish a measurable success criterion to issue #77 and the dashboard stream.
An active execution receipt prevents a newly ranked candidate from replacing unfinished paid work.
An explicitly approved executable candidate is selected ahead of an unapproved higher-ranked candidate.
